claims: The long-term rate applies after 26 of the last 39 weeks on a non-student income support payment, with no dependent child, starting study or an apprenticeship after turning 22 (21 for Austudy).
whys: Austudy is only for people aged 25 and over, so an age condition of '21 for Austudy' looks wrong or garbled. Check the long-term income support student rate conditions against Services Australia.

reviewerNotes: I endorse the writer's fact question about '21 for Austudy' in the long-term rate conditions. Austudy is for people aged 25 and over. The text is unchanged.

claims: In some cases, the Fair Work Ombudsman or courts may award interest on unpaid wages, particularly for prolonged underpayments.
whys: The FWO is a regulator and does not award interest; only a court can order it. This contradicts the page's own FAQ ('Interest is not part of a standard Fair Work claim, but a court can order interest'). The phrase 'particularly for prolonged underpayments' has no source.
constants: n/a (prose); align with BACKPAY_FAQS interest answer in backpay-calculator-faqs.ts
